Kitty in a box.
Warm up!
Draw five little sticks from top to bottom, like rain.
Draw a box.
First the lid, a straight line from left to right.
Now the sides and the bottom, down, right and up.
A kitty peeks out of the box!
A line up, an ear, the top of the head, the second ear and down.
Eyes, two little sticks from top to bottom.
And a pointy nose.
Whiskers!
Long straight lines to the sides.
Kitty behind the fence.
Fence, even sticks from top to bottom.
Crossbars, two long lines from left to right.
A kitty peeks over the fence, a line up, an ear, the top of the head, an ear and down.
Stick eyes and a pointy nose.
Whiskers to the sides.
Grass by the fence, short slanted sticks.
Robot kitty.
Robot head, a rectangle.
Ears and an antenna, straight lines.
Eyes are little squares, the mouth is a line with teeth.
Neck and body, a big rectangle.
A panel with buttons on the body.
Arms and legs, straight lines.
Rocket kitty.
Rocket body, a tall rectangle.
Rocket nose, two slanted lines up to a sharp tip.
Wings, slanted lines on the sides.
A square window with a kitty in it, a line up, ears and down.
Fire below, a sharp zigzag.
Little cross stars all around.
Round kitty.
Draw three circles.
Start at the top, go left around and come back to the start.
Draw a big circle.
This is a round kitty.
Ears, little corners on top.
Up and down.
Eyes, two little circles.
Nose, a tiny little circle.
And whiskers to the sides.
Next to it, a ball of yarn, a circle with arcs inside.
Kitty and bubbles.
Kitty's head, a big circle and ears.
Circle eyes and a circle nose.
Kitty is blowing bubbles!
A big circle.
More bubbles, a middle one and little ones.
A little circle shines in every bubble.
Whiskers for kitty.
Mouse friend.
Mouse head, a circle.
Ears, two big circles on top.
Where they go behind the head, we don't draw the line.
Smaller circles inside the ears.
Eyes and a big round nose.
Whiskers and a smile.
Caterpillar.
Caterpillar head, a circle on the right.
Body, circles one after another.
Each one hides behind its neighbour.
Circle eyes and a smile.
Antennae with little balls.
Legs, short sticks under each circle.
The twig the caterpillar is crawling on.
Big eared face.
Draw three triangles, from the top down to the left, then to the right and back to the top.
This is kitty's head.
Ears, triangle corners on top of the head.
Smaller triangles inside the ears.
Eyes are little circles, and the nose is a small triangle.
The mouth is two little arcs under the nose.
And whiskers!
Little fox.
The fox's face, a big triangle with the nose pointing down.
Ears, corners on top.
Smaller corners inside the ears.
Eyes and a nose on the tip.
White cheeks, two lines making a corner.
Party kitty.
Face, a circle and ears.
Leave space on top for the party hat.
Party hat, a triangle on top of the head and a pompom.
Eyes and nose.
Mouth and whiskers.
Triangle flags on a string.
Mountains.
The front mountain, a big triangle.
The mountain behind, we only draw what we can see behind the first one.
Snow on the peaks, a zigzag.
The sun and little birds.
Ground below and a kitty.
Stripy kitty.
Draw three waves, like the sea, up and down, up and down.
Draw the face like before, a circle and two ears.
This kitty is stripy!
Three wavy stripes on the forehead, from top to bottom.
Wavy stripes on the cheeks too.
Done!
Kitty in a boat.
The boat, wide on top, narrow at the bottom.
A kitty in the boat, head and ears.
Kitty's face.
Waves under the boat.
Smaller waves far away.
Fish in the sea.
A big fish, an oval and a tail.
Scales, wavy stripes.
Seaweed, wavy lines from bottom to top.
Bubbles rising up.
Waves on the surface of the sea.
Kitty in the bath.
The edge of the bath, a long line.
The bottom of the bath, an arc and little legs.
Kitty is sitting in the water, we see the head with ears.
Face and whiskers.
Water in the bath, a wavy line.
Soap bubbles.
Fluffy kitty.
Draw zigzags, up and down with sharp corners, like little teeth.
This kitty is fluffy!
Draw the head as a zigzag going round, tooth, tooth, tooth.
Corner ears.
A zigzag on top, a fluffy tuft of hair.
Hedgehog.
The hedgehog's prickly back, a zigzag in an arc, up from the ground and down.
Face, a pointy nose forward.
Tummy, a line along the ground.
An eye and a round nose.
Paws and an apple on the prickles.
Kitty and the Christmas tree.
Christmas tree, three layers of teeth, from the top down and back up.
Trunk, two sticks down.
A star on top.
Baubles on the branches.
A kitty next to it.
Ground.
King kitty.
Crown, a zigzag with sharp points.
The head under the crown.
Where the crown is, we don't draw the line.
Ears peek out from under the crown.
Little jewels on the crown.
His Majesty the kitty!
Sleepy kitty.
Draw two spirals, like a snail's shell, from the middle going round, wider and wider.
Kitty is asleep!
This is the back.
A smaller circle on the side.
This is the head.
Corner ears on the head.
Kitty has closed its eyes, two little arcs.
The tail is curled into a spiral, go round, smaller and smaller.
Kitty is snoring.
Draw sleepy zigzags, z z z!
Snail.
The snail's shell, a spiral from the middle, wider and wider.
The snail's body, a long line along the ground and the head going up.
Feelers with little balls at the ends.
An eye and a smile.
Grass all around.
Kitty with a lollipop.
Lollipop, a spiral from the middle.
Draw a circle around the lollipop and add a stick.
Kitty, head and ears.
Kitty licks its lips!
Little lamb.
The lamb's wool, lots of little spirals in a circle.
More spirals to make the lamb fluffy.
Face, an oval on the right.
Ears, eyes and nose.
Legs and grass.
The whole kitty.
Draw ovals, they are squashed circles, one lying down, one standing and a small one.
Draw a big standing oval.
This is kitty's body.
A circle on top.
Two small ovals at the bottom.
These are the paws.
A long tail, draw an arc up and curl the tip.
Face, eyes, nose and whiskers.
Bunny.
The bunny's body, a standing oval.
Head, a circle on top.
Long ears, thin ovals going up.
Paws are ovals at the bottom, the tail is a little circle on the side.
Face, eyes, nose, teeth and whiskers.
Little bird.
The bird's body, a lying oval, tilted a little.
Head, a circle at the top right.
Wing, an oval on the body.
A triangle beak and an eye.
Tail, sharp corners at the back.
The feet hold on to a branch.
Penguin.
The penguin's body, a big standing oval.
White tummy, a smaller oval inside.
Flippers, thin ovals on the sides.
Eyes and beak.
Feet, ovals at the bottom.
And snow.
Coloured kitty.
Draw two squares and fill them with little sticks, close together and nice and even.
Draw the face, a circle and two ears.
Hatch the ears, short lines from left to right, close together.
Stripes on the forehead, short lines from top to bottom.
Now colour the kitty with coloured pencils!
Stripy fish.
A big fish, a lying oval.
Tail and fin.
An eye and a mouth.
Hatch three wide stripes with lines from top to bottom.
Bubbles.
House with a roof.
Walls, a square.
Roof, a triangle.
Hatch the roof with slanted lines.
A door and a window with a cross.
Hatch the door from top to bottom.
Tiger cub.
Hatch the ears.
Stripes on the forehead, three narrow stripes, hatch them thickly.
Stripes on the cheeks.
Grrr!
Mum and kitten.
Draw circles, big, medium and really small.
Draw mummy cat, a big circle and ears.
Mummy's face, eyes, nose, mouth.
Next to her is a kitten.
It is small, so the circle is small too.
The kitten's face.
Everything like mummy's, only smaller.
Whiskers for mummy and the kitten.
Kitty and mouse.
Big kitty, body and head.
Ears, face, whiskers and tail.
Little mouse, an oval body and a little head.
The mouse's ear, eye and tail.
Big and small fish.
A big fish.
A smaller fish.
And really tiny fish.
Bubbles, big and small.
Mum and kittens.
Mummy cat is big, body and head.
Mummy's ears, face, whiskers and tail.
The first kitten is small, all the same, only smaller.
The second kitten is even smaller.
Ground and a heart above them.
Kitty goes for a walk.
Draw lying ovals, two smaller ones and one long one.
Kitty is walking past us, we see it from the side.
Body, a long lying oval.
Head, a circle at the front, a bit higher than the body.
Corner ears on top.
Four paws, thin ovals going down.
Two at the back and two at the front.
The tail is up.
From the side we see only one eye.
Nose, mouth and whiskers at the front.
Kitty walks on the ground, draw a line under the paws.
Doggy.
We draw the doggy from the side too.
Body, a long oval.
The head is a circle, and in front a muzzle oval.
A floppy ear.
Nose, eye and mouth.
Four paws and a little tail.
Kitty sitting sideways.
Kitty is sitting sideways to us.
Body, a standing oval.
Head on top, a little forward.
Ears and face from the side, eye, nose, whiskers.
Front paw, a thin oval going down.
The tail wraps around the paws.
Running mouse.
The mouse's body from the side, a lying oval.
Head, a long oval with a pointy nose.
A round ear.
Eye, nose and whiskers.
Paws and a long tail.
Three moods.
Draw arcs, a happy smile, a sad arc and a small circle.
Draw three kitty heads, three circles with ears.
The first kitty is happy, arc eyes and a smiling mouth.
The second kitty is sad, dot eyes, worried eyebrows and a mouth curving down.
The third kitty is surprised, big round eyes and a mouth like the letter O.
Give everyone whiskers.
Which kitty do you like best?
Angry and sleepy.
Two heads with ears.
Angry kitty, eyebrows down towards the nose, eyes and a mouth curving down.
Sleepy kitty, eyes closed, a small mouth.
Sleepy zigzags above the head.
Whiskers for both.
Winking kitty.
One eye is open and the other is winking, an arc.
Nose and a big smile with a tongue.
Whiskers and a heart nearby.
Scared and in love.
Scared kitty, fur standing up, a zigzag head.
And ears.
Big eyes with tiny pupils.
The mouth is trembling.
Kitty in love, a circle and ears.
Heart eyes and a smile.
Pink cheeks, hatch little circles.
And hearts above the head.
Running kitty.
Draw slanted sticks, as if a strong wind is blowing.
Kitty is running!
Body, an oval tilted up a little, as if kitty is rushing forward.
Head at the front.
Front paws stretched forward and down.
Back paws push off backwards.
The tail is stretched back, like a rocket's.
Speed lines behind kitty, short sticks.
Whoosh!
Jumping kitty.
The jump line, very lightly draw a high arc.
Kitty at the very top.
Body, a stretched oval.
Head, ears and face.
Front paws reach forward, back paws backward.
Tail.
Ground, where kitty jumped from and where it will land.
Bouncing ball.
The ball's path, lightly draw bounces, each lower than the last.
In the air the ball is round.
And when it hits the ground, it squashes into an oval.
Little impact lines by the ground.
Kitty is watching the ball.
Kitty's footprints.
Kitty walked through the snow.
Lightly draw the path it took.
Paw prints, a pad and four toes.
Left, right.
Further on the prints get smaller, because they go into the distance.
And here is kitty itself.
Snowflakes.
Kitty outdoors.
Draw little clouds, a straight line at the bottom, bumps on top.
Ground below, a long line across the whole page.
The sky is above.
The sun with rays in the corner.
Clouds float across the sky.
A kitty sits on the ground, body and head.
Ears, face and tail.
Zigzag grass along the ground.
Kitty under an umbrella.
Rain clouds, a straight line at the bottom, bumps on top.
Rain, short slanted sticks.
Umbrella, an arched top and a wavy edge.
The umbrella handle.
Kitty under the umbrella.
Ground and a puddle.
Night.
Hills, a wavy line.
Where kitty sits, we don't draw the line.
Moon, a crescent made of two arcs.
Stars.
Kitty sits with its back to us and looks at the moon.
Rainbow.
Rainbow, a big arc.
Three more arcs inside, one under another.
Little clouds at the ends of the rainbow.
Kitty under the rainbow.
Ground and sun.
A house for kitty.
Draw two little houses, a square with a triangle roof on top.
House walls, a big square.
Roof, a triangle on top.
Door, a tall rectangle and a round handle.
Window, a square.
A kitty in the window!
We only see the head, a circle down to the windowsill and ears.
Kitty's face in the window.
A chimney on the roof and smoke.
Kitty in a car.
The car body, a long rectangle.
Where the wheels are, we don't draw the line.
The cabin on top, a trapezium.
Windows, a stick in the middle.
Wheels, circles with little circles inside.
Kitty is driving!
We only see the head in the window.
Headlight and road.
Little ship.
The ship's hull, wide on top, narrow at the bottom.
Mast, a tall stick.
A triangle sail and a flag.
Kitty on deck.
Portholes and waves.
Little train.
The engine cab, a tall rectangle with a window in it.
Kitty the engine driver in the window.
Boiler, a lying rectangle, and a chimney.
Smoke, little round clouds.
A carriage and a coupling.
Wheels and rails.
Fisher kitty.
Draw fish, an oval and a triangle tail.
Kitty caught a fish!
First the head.
Ears and face.
The fish in its paws, an oval and a tail.
The fish's eye and scales.
Kitty's body, an oval behind the fish.
Where the fish is, we don't draw the line.
Kitty's tail and whiskers.
Kitty with a balloon.
Kitty, body and head.
Ears, face and whiskers.
Balloon, a standing oval and a knot.
A shine on the balloon and a string to kitty's paw.
Kitty in a scarf.
Leave space for the scarf.
A scarf around the neck, two arcs.
The end of the scarf hangs down, with fringe at the bottom.
Stripes on the scarf.
Chef kitty.
Leave space on top for the chef's hat.
Chef's hat, a puffy cloud and a band.
Ears peek out from under the hat.
A big spoon in its paw.
Mirror kitty.
Butterfly, very lightly draw a helper line, then a wing on the left and the same one on the right.
Very lightly draw a helper line down the middle of the page.
You can rub it out later.
The left half of the head and the left ear.
Now the right half, like in a mirror.
The left eye and whiskers on the left.
The right eye and whiskers on the right.
Just like on the left!
Nose and mouth right on the middle line.
Butterfly.
A helper line in the middle, very lightly.
Body, a thin oval on the line.
Top wing on the left, then the same one on the right.
Bottom wings, the same on the left and right.
Patterns, a circle on the left and the same on the right.
Feelers.
Owl.
A helper line in the middle.
The left half of the owl with a feather ear, then the right half.
Big eyes, circles with smaller circles inside.
A triangle beak in the middle.
Wings on the sides, arcs.
Feathers on the chest, little ticks, the same on the left and right.
Feet on a branch.
Ladybird.
Back, a half on the left, then the same on the right.
Little head on top.
Spots, on the left and the same on the right.
Legs, three on the left and three on the right.
Kitty watches the sunset.
Draw long straight lines from left to right.
Take your time.
Draw the horizon line across the whole page.
It is where the sky meets the ground.
The sun is setting behind the horizon, only half of it shows above the line.
Rays going up and to the sides.
Kitty sits with its back to us and watches the sunset.
Head and ears.
Back, a big oval under the head.
The tail lies next to it, the tip curled.
Birds in the sky, little ticks.
Sea and a little ship.
Horizon, where the sea meets the sky.
The sun is high in the sky.
A faraway ship on the horizon, really tiny.
Waves, bigger near us, smaller at the horizon.
The shore below.
Where kitty is, we don't draw the line.
Kitty on the shore watches the ship.
Path through the field.
Path, wide at the bottom, narrowing towards the horizon.
A little house far away on the horizon, really tiny.
Sun.
Grass in the field, tall nearby, small far away.
Kitty on the path.
Desert.
A huge sun above the horizon.
Dunes, smooth waves of sand.
A cactus with arms.
A small cactus far away.
Kitty looks at the sun.
Kitties in the field.
Draw three little circles, a big one at the bottom, a medium one higher up and a small one almost at the very top.
Draw the horizon higher up.
The kitty near us is big and sits at the bottom of the page.
Its face and whiskers.
A kitty further away, smaller and higher.
And this one is very far away, tiny, right at the horizon.
The grass too, tall nearby, short far away.
Fir trees in the forest.
The near fir tree, big, standing low.
A fir tree further away, smaller and higher.
Faraway fir trees, tiny, right at the horizon.
Kitty by the big fir tree.
Village houses.
The near house, big, at the bottom of the page.
A house further away, smaller and higher.
A very faraway house at the horizon.
Windows in the houses.
Kitty by the near house.
Hot air balloons.
Horizon low down.
The near balloon, big.
In the sky it's the other way round, the further away a balloon is, the smaller it is and the closer to the horizon.
A very faraway balloon at the horizon.
Segments on the balloons.
Kitty on the ground looks up.
Two friends.
Draw a circle and a second one behind it.
The second one is hiding, so we draw only the part we can see.
First the kitty in front, a circle and ears.
The second kitty sits behind.
Its head hides behind the first one, we draw only what we can see.
The second kitty's ears.
Where an ear hides behind its friend, we don't draw the line.
The second kitty's face.
Whoever is in front is seen whole!
Kitty behind a bush.
A bush in front, three puffy bumps.
The bottom of the bush is flat, a line along the ground.
A kitty peeks out from behind the bush.
We draw only what we can see.
Leaves on the bush, little arcs.
Three balls.
The front ball, a whole circle.
The second ball is behind it, we draw only the part we can see.
The third ball is the furthest, it hides behind both.
Stripes on the balls, also only where we can see them.
A star on the front ball.
Kitty behind a mug.
A mug in front, an oval top, sides and bottom.
The mug's handle and a heart on it.
Kitty's paws on the edge of the mug.
Kitty behind the mug, we draw only what we can see.
A ball for kitty.
Draw three circles and hatch each one on one side only, bottom right.
First the sun in the corner.
The light comes from it.
This is the ball.
Highlight, a little circle on the sun's side.
We don't colour it.
On the other side, where the sun doesn't shine, the ball is in shadow.
Hatch the edge at the bottom right.
The ball casts a shadow on the ground, a squashed oval next to it.
Hatch the shadow more thickly.
Apple.
The sun at the top left.
Apple, two round sides with a dip on top.
Stalk and leaf.
A highlight on the sun's side.
Form shadow, hatch the bottom right side.
The shadow on the table, to the right of the apple.
Snowman.
The bottom snowball, a big circle.
Its top hides behind the middle ball.
The middle snowball.
Head.
There will be a bucket on it.
Eyes, a carrot nose and buttons.
Twig arms and a bucket on the head.
Light from the left.
Hatch the dark side of each snowball.
Shadow on the snow to the right.
Ball of yarn.
Sun on the left.
Ball of yarn, a big circle.
Threads on the ball, slanted ovals inside.
A thread runs away from the ball.
Form shadow, hatch the bottom right edge.
The shadow on the floor.
Kitty and the cube.
Draw three squares, big, medium and small.
Draw a square.
This is the front of the cube.
From three corners draw short slanted lines up and to the right.
All the same!
Join them, the top and the right side.
You've made a solid cube!
The sun shines from the left, so the right side is in shadow.
Hatch it.
The cube casts a shadow to the right.
Draw it and hatch it.
A kitty sits next to it and looks at the cube.
Tower of blocks.
Big cube, a square in front.
The top and side of the big cube.
Leave space where the small cube will be.
Small cube on top, a square.
Its top and side.
Light from the left, hatch the right sides.
Kitty sits on the small cube.
A present for kitty.
Box cube, a square in front.
Top and side.
Ribbon, stripes on the front, top and side.
A bow on top, two loops and a knot.
Hatch the dark side.
A kitty next to it waits for the present.
Front wall, a square.
The top and side of the house.
A round doorway.
Kitty inside the house, we only see its face.
It's dark inside, hatch around kitty.
